citations.title: The coalescent

frozen_object.allowed_data: exact integer block rates, rational time/Laplace sentinels and source-local partition combinatorics
frozen_object.arithmetic_origin: none; this is a scope-locked non-arithmetic genealogical process
frozen_object.clock: physical elapsed time; no fitted or logarithmic clock
frozen_object.determinant_convention: none; finite Markov transition determinants are not Artin--Mazur zeta functions
frozen_object.forbidden_data: prime/zero tables, target labels, fitted rates, Euler factors and external observations
frozen_object.generator: Q_{k,k-1}=lambda_k=C(k,2), Q_{k,k}=-lambda_k for k>=2, and Q_{1,1}=0
frozen_object.normalization: probability on labelled partitions; conditional on k blocks each merger pair is uniform
frozen_object.parameters: sample size n>=1 and physical time t>=0
frozen_object.phase_space: partitions of [n] for every n>=1, with projective restriction maps
frozen_object.process: each unordered pair of current blocks merges at rate 1; the block-counting state is K_t

headline: The partition-valued Kingman coalescent has an exact all-n genealogy, hypoexponential block transitions and branch-length laws
nonclaims: priority or novelty for the Kingman coalescent or its classical distribution formulae
a finite n grid proves the all-n projective theorem
a Markov transition determinant, trace-log, or Laplace product is an Artin--Mazur zeta, Euler factor, or target determinant
genealogical block counts or branch lengths have arithmetic-prime meaning
a Hilbert-Polya operator, target divisor, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, external review, or Route-B authorization

limit_rows.coupling_statement: under the standard projective coupling T_n increases to a finite T_infinity almost surely

route_a.strongest_failure: There is no intrinsic rational-prime carrier, primitive periodic-orbit clock, arithmetic divisor, or natural Hilbert-Polya lift.
route_a.strongest_positive: A source-locked partition genealogy closes all-n block transitions, independent holding times, MRCA and total-branch-length laws including exact CDF.

theorem.block_rates: K_t is pure death k->k-1 with lambda_k=C(k,2), k>=2, and state 1 absorbing
theorem.branch_cdf: P(L_n<=ell)=(1-exp(-ell/2))^(n-1) for ell>=0, with the n=1 convention L_1=0
theorem.determinant_boundary: a finite Markov matrix determinant or trace-log is not an Artin--Mazur dynamical zeta and is not used as one
theorem.independent_holdings: holding times E_k are independent Exp(lambda_k), independent of the uniform pair-merger jump chain
theorem.infinite_absorption: under projective coupling T_n increases to finite T_infinity almost surely; mean limit 2 and variance limit 4*(2*zeta(2)-3)
theorem.n1_boundary: n=1 has one partition, K_t=1, T_1=L_1=0 and all transforms equal 1
theorem.partition_owner: Kingman n-coalescent on labelled set partitions, consistent under restriction from n+1 to n
theorem.total_branch_length: L_n=sum_{k=2}^n k E_k is a sum of independent Exp((k-1)/2) variables; LT=prod_{j=1}^{n-1}(j/2)/(j/2+s), mean=2 H_{n-1}, variance=4 H_{n-1}^{(2)}
